description: This file contains mixins for generating grid classes for the Bootstrap framework, utilizing loops and mixin parametrization to dynamically generate grid-related CSS classes for different screen sizes and layouts.

methods.name: make-grid
methods.description: Creates a complete grid for a specific class by including float, width, push, pull, and offset configurations.

methods.name: make-grid-columns
methods.description: Generates column classes for a range of grid columns with relative positioning and gutter padding.

methods.name: float-grid-columns
methods.description: Generates floating classes for grid columns of a specific class.

methods.name: calc-grid-column
methods.description: Calculates and creates CSS rules for width, push, pull, and offset based on grid index and class.

methods.name: loop-grid-columns
methods.description: Loops through column indices to generate classes for width, push, pull, and offset variations.
